name: v0.8.6
body:
## What's Changed
* site: refresh the release snapshot to v0.8.5 by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/147
* fix(ui): name the text fields a real AT pass found unnamed (#72) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/148
* feat(board): a shape with no label can be given one (#73) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/149
* fix(ui): audit layer_03, overlays and palette swatch rings (#72) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/150
* feat(board): link shapes and board text to vault notes (#73) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/151
* i18n: add the muninn-i18n catalog seam (#153) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/161
* i18n: split file and display date formatting (#154) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/162
* i18n: move Help copy into the catalog (#155, part 1) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/163
* i18n: move command palette copy into the catalog (#155, part 2) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/164
* i18n: move Settings and Kanban schema copy into the catalog (#156, part 1) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/165
* i18n: move Sync settings copy into the catalog (#156, part 2) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/166
* i18n: move Kanban chrome into the catalog (#157, part 1) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/167
* i18n: move Board and Graph chrome into the catalog (#157, part 2) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/168
* test(sync): bound the Tailscale host-stop wait (#170) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/171
* test(ui): wait for the new note, not for any poll change (#172) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/173
* i18n: move status, recovery, trash and tray copy into the catalog (#158, part 1) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/169
* i18n: move user-facing errors and conflict copy into the catalog (#158, part 2) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/175
* i18n: move sync runtime status and error copy into the catalog (#158, part 3) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/176
* i18n: extract the remaining app chrome (#174) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/177
* i18n: add xtask i18n-lint and wire it into check/CI (#159, part 1) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/178
* i18n: add the pseudo-locale render check (#159, part 2) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/179
* docs(i18n): link the filed Rune RTL upstream request (#160) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/180
* Release 0.8.6: bump version and changelog by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/181


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/compare/v0.8.5...v0.8.6
